name: new-client-onboarding
description: Generic new-client / new-matter onboarding checklist. No statutory deadlines — a simple, practice-area-agnostic task set for opening any matter cleanly. A good starting point to copy and adapt.

tasks.name: Run conflict check against all parties
Send and execute engagement / fee agreement
Send and obtain signed contingency fee agreement
Collect client ID, contact info, and preferred communication method
Open matter in Clio and set responsible attorney
Send new-client welcome letter setting expectations and next steps
Calendar all known deadlines for the matter
Schedule initial strategy call with the responsible attorney
30-day file review to confirm intake is complete
